entry.title: When will Cold Snap return to ARC Raiders? Exact date and time
entry.summary:
The winter might be over in ARC Raiders, but the Cold Snap modifier will be back as a permanent addition to the Topside very soon.
Cold Snap was removed after completion of the Flickering Flames project earlier in January. However, Embark has announced that the map event will be back in the rotation pool. ARC Raiders Cold Snap release date and time
The Cold Snap map modifier will be available in ARC Raiders on Feb. 10. This is a permanent addition that will be present until Embark removes it once again. The rotation should be available at 12am PT/2am CT/3am ET/8am UTC/9am CET, which is the usual reset time.
However, the Cold Snap update might not be available immediately, since Embark will add it to the pool of map modifier rotations. Everything depends on how frequent Cold Snap will be as per the schedule. Some modifiers, like Bird City is only available on Buried City.

Since we have already had Cold Snap in the past, we have a fair idea about the challenges we will face. For starters, the parts of the map in Cold Snap will be completely frozen, and we will take damage by being exposed to the cold.
There should be exclusive resources like Candleberries that can only be found on the frozen lands. Last time, we had to collect them to complete the Flickering Flames project. It's different this time around, but there could be more use for Candleberries.

entry.title: How to get Azure Soul Ores in Nioh 3
entry.summary:
Nioh 3 is finally here. Much like its predecessors, its core gameplay heavily relies on proper builds and equipment, with players able to find literally thousands of items around the world, each of which could be a crucial component to any given build.
But once you've found all that you want, you may want to upgrade it yourself or perhaps even craft an entire build from scratch. One of the strongest and most potent upgrades is Soul Matching, by which you'll be able to use Azure Soul Ores to add +value to your equipment, boosting its stats tremendously.
This Ore is very difficult to come by, so here's everything you need to know.
Where to find Azure Soul Ores in Nioh 3
This Shrine Maiden's Hakama is a +1 item that I found near the end of the Warring States storyline. Screenshot by Destructoid
Azure Soul Ores are solely obtainable by performing Soul Extraction at the Blacksmith on items with +value upgrades already on them. This means that you'll need a weapon or armor with +1 or +2 or more on it already and then perform Soul Extraction (the same way you would if you're looking for Yellow Soul Ores).
These items are exceptionally rare, and I've only been able to find six of them in over 30 hours of gameplay. Most of what I did find was in the Warring States map, both as quest rewards during those initial couple dozen levels and as rare drops from powerful enemies.
My advice would be to seek out any and all challenges the game has to offer, as fighting strong bosses is just about the best way to obtain Azure Soul Ores. Closing Crucibles around the maps could put you up against waves of strong opponents, further increasing the odds of +value weapons dropping.

entry.title: “You gotta let some of the chaos in”: Diablo 2's art lead explains what he doesn’t like about Diablo 4
entry.summary:
Last week, Moon Beast Productions officially revealed Darkhaven, a new action-RPG in the spirit of Diablo II, but with a changing, destructible, procedurally generated world that both echoes Minecraft and takes inspiration from the Diablo modding scene. Moon Beast are made up of ARPG royalty – their senior staff include original Diablo senior designer, art director and writer Erich Schaefer, Diablo 2 art lead Philip Shenk and Diablo 2 programmer Peter Hu.
As you’d expect, the Darkhaven devs have many Thoughts about Diablo today, at once leveraging their credits for marketing (they're about to launch a Kickstarter) and resisting the idea that they are making an unofficial Diablo sequel. I don't get the sense that any of them outright despise Diablo IV - summarised by Alice Bell as "2023's prettiest RSI machine" - but Shenk in particular argues that the game has squandered “the magic” of previous games by focussing on smooth progression and balancing and in general, “overly engineering the experience” in order to keep people glued to the game’s live service.

entry.title: USN-8018-1: Python vulnerabilities
entry.summary:
Denis Ledoux discovered that Python incorrectly parsed email message headers. An attacker could possibly use this issue to inject arbitrary headers into email messages. This issue only affected python3.6, python3.7, python3.8, python3.9, python3.10, python3.11, python3.12, python3.13, and python3.14 packages. (CVE-2025-11468)
Jacob Walls, Shai Berger, and Natalia Bidart discovered that Python inefficiently parsed XML input with quadratic complexity. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service. (CVE-2025-12084)
It was discovered that Python incorrectly parsed malicious plist files. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause Python to use excessive resources, leading to a denial of service. This issue only affected python3.5, python3.6, python3.7, python3.8, python3.9, python3.10, python3.11, python3.12, python3.13, and python3.14 packages. (CVE-2025-13837)
Omar Hasan discovered that Python incorrectly parsed URL mediatypes. An attacker could possibly use this issue to inject arbitrary HTTP headers. (CVE-2025-15282)
Omar Hasan discovered that Python incorrectly parsed malicious IMAP inputs. An attacker could possibly use this issue to inject arbitrary IMAP commands. (CVE-2025-15366)
Omar Hasan discovered that Python incorrectly parsed malicious POP3 inputs. An attacker could possibly use this issue to inject arbitrary POP3 commands. (CVE-2025-15367)
Omar Hasan discovered that Python incorrectly parsed malicious HTTP cookie headers. An attacker could possibly use this issue to inject arbitrary HTTP headers. (CVE-2026-0672)

Yapyap stands apart from other “friendslop” horror extraction games by giving you plenty of firepower to begin with. Airpower, anyway. You and up to four mates are the boggle-eyed, flap-jawed minions of an enormous, moon-masked wizard. You’ve been summoned to wreak havoc on a rival wizard’s procedurally generated tower. Wind magic is the Ringo Starr of the four elements, IMO, but the default wands are fun, especially given that you have unlimited mana. entry.title: Pathologic 3 is the rare game about healing that knows healing can be cruel
entry.summary:
Videogames have given us many fascinating healing mechanics and ideas about healing, from the motley support playstyles of Overwatch to the musical cooldown management of Wild Growth, but one thing developers rarely capture is that healing is an expression of power over somebody. However kind, it has the potential to be demeaning, intrusive, even abusive. In my experience of doctors and hospitals, healing is a competition between interpretations of sickness and injury, where the doctor has at their disposal all the crushing cultural authority and ornate vocabularies of modern medicine. The patient’s own self-knowledge - amassed over years of living in and with their own flesh - risks being recast as 'amateurish'. And this is before we get into the weeds of different conceptions of bodies and how they relate, which a doctor - especially an overworked, desensitised one, fighting a wider crisis - might be inclined to dismiss as mysticism or superstition.

entry.title: Jetpacking space pirates taught me a painful lesson in punishing strategy game Menace
entry.summary: There's an accidental element of roleplaying to the Early Access launch of Menace, the latest turn-based tactics game from Battle Brothers developers Overhype Studios. Like the newly-minted commander of the TCRN Impetus, thrust into leadership after a warp travel accident left everyone on the bridge of the colonial navy ship violently decompressed, I too have very little idea what I'm doing. As in the 2025 report, this year’s responses signal a growing discontent with generative AI tools, with opposing sentiments tipping into simple majority status for the first time: 52% now say GenAI is having a negative impact on the industry, up from 30% in 2025 and 18% in 2024. entry.summary: A landmark copyright battle involving digital copies of the iconic Anne Frank diary is helping to answer key questions about geo-blocking and a copyright enforcement tool. entry.summary: Slušně řemeslně zvládnutý film se slušnými hereckými výkony (včetně Helenky), který doplácí na extrémně odbytý scénář. Ten se snaží na úkor nejzákladnější dějové logiky dostrkat děj do kýžených situací ("Klučina začne dělat různé průšvihy v lázních"), které pak trestuhodně nevyužije. To, co se zdá být hlavní zápletkou (t.j. "Manželka odhalí, že jí manžel byl nevěrný a má syna s milenkou") začne až nějakých 20 minut před koncem a neobsahuje to žádný pokus o humor. Prostě se komedie najednou změní v drama a očekávaný happyend je 20 minut odkládán, aby nakonec proběhl přesně tak, jak jsem se obával, t.j. "Nevadí, že jsi všem sedm let lhal, stejně tě máme rádi". (Ilča 20 %)

entry.title: Audio recenze: 28 let poté: Chrám z kostí [28 Years Later: The Bone Temple] - 90 %
entry.summary: Trochu jsem se bál, že to po změně režiséra nebude tak dobré jako předchozí film, ale je to ještě o kousek lepší! Nevěřil bych, že to nerežíroval Boyle. Výborná atmosféra, výborní herci a situace/hlášky, které se budou hojně citovat. Vynikající worldbuilding a těším se na další pokračování. (Ilča 80 %)
